name: Custom Shape 4-Layer Acrylic Standing With Led Light
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality acrylic material.
    - Product consists of 4 acrylic layers:
                    +) Layer 1 (Back Layer): Acrylic 3mm – 2-sided printing.
                    +) Layer 2: Acrylic 5mm – No printing (clear support layer)
                    +) Layer 3: Acrylic 3mm – 2-sided printing.
                    +) Layer 4 (Front Decorative Layer): Acrylic 3mm – 2-sided printing.
    - Acrylic base thickness: 5mm.
    - Precision laser-cut for smooth edges and a detailed finish.
    - Durable, sturdy, and long-lasting construction.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    -Available sizes:
                    +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm.
                    +) 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Advanced UV printing technology.
    - High-definition, vibrant colors.
    - Scratch-resistant and fade-resistant finish.
    - Printed layers: 2-sided printing (except Layer 2 – no printing)

 

  • LED Lighting Features:
    - USB powered.
    - Available in:
                    +) 7-color light version (with control switch)
                    +) Monochrome light version (with on/off switch)
    - Soft ambient lighting enhances the layered 3D depth effect.
    - Easy plug-and-play operation.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Decorative tabletop LED display.
    - Ideal for bedrooms, living rooms, offices, and shelves.
    - Modern layered acrylic design with illuminated effect.
    - Personalized custom design for family themes, names, or special messages.
    - Stable acrylic base ensures secure standing display.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Meaningful personalized gift for Mom, Dad, family members, or loved ones.
    - Ideal for Mother's Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays.
    - Unique keepsake combining layered acrylic art and LED lighting.
    - A sentimental decorative piece that lights up memories 🎁.

  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 4-Layer Acrylic Standing With Led Light

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
